szguns.gun.ak74.name: AK-74
szguns.gun.ak74.desc: The Zone workhorse. 5.45x39, soft recoil, shrugs off dirt and frost.
szguns.gun.aks74u.name: AKS-74U
szguns.gun.aks74u.desc: "Ksyukha": a short carbine with a folding stock. A rookie's first serious gun.
szguns.gun.pm.name: PM
szguns.gun.pm.desc: Makarov pistol. Weak, but always at hand.
szguns.gun.toz_obrez.name: Sawn-off TOZ-34
szguns.gun.toz_obrez.desc: A double barrel with the barrels and stock sawn off. Unforgiving up close.
szguns.gun.svd.name: SVD
szguns.gun.svd.desc: Dragunov sniper rifle. One headshot drops a bloodsucker.
szguns.gun.pkm.name: PKM
szguns.gun.pkm.desc: Kalashnikov machine gun. A hundred-round belt; Duty and the military never go without one.
szguns.gun.akm.name: AKM
szguns.gun.akm.desc: Modernised Kalashnikov in 7.62x39: wood furniture, slant brake, hits hard but climbs.
szguns.gun.aks74.name: AKS-74
szguns.gun.aks74.desc: AK-74 with a folding triangular stock: the paratrooper version, lighter on a raid.
szguns.gun.an94.name: AN-94 "Abakan"
szguns.gun.an94.desc: Nikonov rifle: a two-round burst lands almost in one hole. An assaulter's dream.
szguns.gun.vss.name: VSS "Vintorez"
szguns.gun.vss.desc: Silent sniper rifle in 9x39. Quiet, accurate, goes through body armour.
szguns.gun.groza.name: OTs-14 "Groza"
szguns.gun.groza.desc: A 9x39 bullpup built on the AKS-74U: short and hard-hitting, perfect for lab bunkers.
szguns.gun.pb.name: PB
szguns.gun.pb.desc: Silenced pistol built on the PM. Just right for a quiet sentry.
szguns.gun.fort12.name: Fort-12
szguns.gun.fort12.desc: Ukrainian 9x18 pistol: twelve rounds, reliable, on every army and police belt.
szguns.gun.aps.name: APS
szguns.gun.aps.desc: Stechkin automatic pistol: twenty rounds and full auto up close.
szguns.gun.gauss.name: Gauss Rifle
szguns.gun.gauss.desc: Experimental accelerator with an artefact in its core. Punches through an exoskeleton and the wall behind it.
szguns.gun.toz34.name: TOZ-34
szguns.gun.toz34.desc: A hunting double barrel: the first gun and last argument of every Cordon loner.

szguns.ammo.9x39.name: §e9x39mm SP-6 Rounds
